message:
Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/yara && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')
trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"description.txt","function":"<global>","line":1,"var":"testcase","code":"OSS-Fuzz report for yara rules_fuzzer","note":"The vulnerable input is a YARA rules file parsed by the libFuzzer target."},
  {"step":2,"file":"libyara/parser.c","function":"yr_parser_reduce_string_declaration","line":535,"var":"string_flags","code":"string_declarations -> string_declaration","note":"A rule string declaration enters the parser with regexp/hex flags preserved for later AST handling."},
  {"step":3,"file":"libyara/parser.c","function":"yr_parser_reduce_string_declaration","line":571,"var":"re_ast","code":"yr_re_parse(str->c_string, &re_ast, &re_error)","note":"The attacker-controlled regexp text is parsed into an AST."},
  {"step":4,"file":"libyara/re.c","function":"yr_re_ast_split_at_chaining_point","line":456,"var":"re_ast->root_node","code":"if (re_ast->root_node->type != RE_NODE_CONCAT) return ERROR_SUCCESS;","note":"The AST is examined for a concatenation that can be split into chained pieces."},
  {"step":5,"file":"libyara/re.c","function":"yr_re_ast_split_at_chaining_point","line":468,"var":"child","code":"if (!child->greedy && child->type == RE_NODE_RANGE_ANY && (child->start > YR_STRING_CHAINING_THRESHOLD || child->end > YR_STRING_CHAINING_THRESHOLD))","note":"A large non-greedy wildcard range triggers the split path and isolates the suffix AST."},
  {"step":6,"file":"libyara/re.c","function":"yr_re_ast_split_at_chaining_point","line":472,"var":"remainder_re_ast","code":"yr_re_ast_create(remainder_re_ast)","note":"A new AST is allocated for the remainder while the original AST is about to be mutated."},
  {"step":7,"file":"libyara/re.c","function":"yr_re_ast_split_at_chaining_point","line":480,"var":"re_ast->root_node->children_head","code":"re_ast->root_node->children_head = child->next_sibling;","note":"The original AST is detached from the split node, leaving the remainder AST to reference the same root structure."},
  {"step":8,"file":"libyara/re.c","function":"yr_re_ast_split_at_chaining_point","line":493,"var":"child","code":"yr_re_node_destroy(child);","note":"The split node is freed even though the parser still needs the extracted literal from the mutated AST path."},
  {"step":9,"file":"libyara/parser.c","function":"_yr_parser_write_string","line":335,"var":"literal_string","code":"literal_string = yr_re_ast_extract_literal(re_ast);","note":"The parser extracts a literal from the AST after the split, using the mutated tree state."},
  {"step":10,"file":"libyara/re.c","function":"yr_re_ast_extract_literal","line":365,"var":"child","code":"child = re_ast->root_node->children_tail; while (child != NULL && child->type == RE_NODE_LITERAL)","note":"Literal extraction walks the AST nodes that were just rearranged by the split logic."},
  {"step":11,"file":"libyara/parser.c","function":"_yr_parser_write_string","line":383,"var":"literal_string->c_string","code":"yr_atoms_extract_from_string(..., (uint8_t*) literal_string->c_string, (int32_t) literal_string->length, ...)","note":"The extracted literal bytes are consumed to build atoms, dereferencing data that can now be stale after the AST mutation/free sequence."}
]
p.write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, indent=2))
print(p.read_text())
PY
bash submit.sh /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/yara/sample.rules /workspace/candidate_trace.json >/tmp/submit.log 2>&1; ec=$?; echo EXIT:$ec; cat /tmp/submit.log | tail -80
